scenario: delete a prepared canonical-backed session through packaged UI, then cold-restart and verify it does not reappear

isolation.createdAs: filesystem copy of a previously used synthetic prepared-append profile; original profile left unchanged

uiAutomation.method: CDP Runtime.evaluate HTMLElement.click on the product delete control and confirmation button

result: pass: product UI/IPC deletion removed all target rows, and a cold restart did not restore the deleted session
limitations: single synthetic profile sample; PKG was not installed
UI action was dispatched through CDP DOM click, not physical mouse input
does not cover publication-boundary crash, real history, or the AC-7 baseline/candidate performance comparison
